domain: Lowercase word length1..100000;1..100000 forbidden lowercase strings, each length1..10.
local_effect_policy: read-only arguments; fresh mutable returns and no output-to-input aliases; explicit local policy, not official mutation requirement
objective: Length of longest contiguous substring containing no forbidden string as substring; empty allowed.
result_semantics: Length of longest contiguous substring containing no forbidden string as substring; empty allowed.

source_complexity_review.property: Sliding left boundary from latest forbidden start, set lookup over suffixes of length<=10; O(n*L^2+F) expected time including slicing and hashing.
source_complexity_review.status: both exact owner sources statically reviewed, not executed
